changes: Large nonfused ordinary/wide SDPA and SinkAttention use bounded full-KV Q blocks with a balanced explicit concat frontier. Existing multi-node/published-intermediate dependencies stay native dataflow; no implicit CPY frontier, Graph gate, support decline, new API or option.

All these math paths now request QK/PV F32 source precision as well as F32 accumulation. Query is made native dim01-contiguous in F32 (per block for tiled path) because the existing Vulkan dispatcher otherwise widens a noncontiguous input through Half even with the source flag. Fused FullF32/paged paths are unchanged.

strategy.score_budget_note: Conservative four F32 score-sized buffers; a row alignment quantum can exceed this target. It is not an allocation rejection or hard VRAM limit.
strategy.alignment: block rows is a multiple of alignment/gcd(alignment, query row pitch) and mask row pitch. Native minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment from the actual device; mask pitch remains original caller pitch.
strategy.benefit_guard: (Q-block_rows)*KV > 2*Q*Dout; otherwise preserve untiled math. Wide integer arithmetic follows already validated tensor extents. This is a conservative internal strategy estimate, not a measured throughput guarantee.
strategy.shared: Full-KV key cast and value transpose/contiguous payload are built once outside blocks. F32 query copies are per block.
strategy.bottom_right: n_past=KV-total_Q+block_begin; caller Sink mask row view begins at block_begin*original_mask.nb1, sinks vector is unchanged per head.
strategy.frontier_cost: Balanced output copies cost O(output*log(block_count)) work and linear live output storage; this is explicit overhead, not zero-copy output or only one block of total memory.
strategy.metadata: 16 extra tensor/node slots per block, checked against INT32_MAX/4 before multiplication. Unique space cold lowering observed capacity359,tensors200,nodes195,metadata_used91984B.

tests.original_baseline: Three strict FP64 numeric tests FAIL before correction: wide F32 maxAbs2.7068e-5, MLA1.05463e-5, Sink3.61353e-6. Initial F16 rounded oracle passed. Logs/source retained.
tests.precision_corrected_baseline: Final numeric3/3 PASS. Space regression expected FAIL only backing threshold; analytic output check still passes.
tests.final_candidate: 4/4 PASS; two independent buffer sets, replay/rebind, previous output retained, attention intermediate published with downstream Neg in same Region. Original short-KV controls stay untiled. Three natural long-KV representatives actually tile: B2/F16 wide noncausal/zero scale; F32 MLA576-to512 causal/negative scale; F32 Sink with row-dependent nonzero/full-masked mask and per-head sinks. Existing short domains retain negative/positive/zero scale checks.
tests.oracle: Independent FP64 stable softmax from exact dyadic actual input values. Q/K have one nonzero channel; token-dependent plus channel-dependent V permits exact separable FP64 reference without an enormous CPU D inner loop. All output elements and downstream negatives checked; final F16 rounding is explicit.
tests.public_generic_graph: Not separately rebuilt/run; actual Region multi-node native submission and published-intermediate binding tested. Existing Graph route/gates unchanged.

space.oracle: .25*2049/2050 from Q=K=mask=sinks=0,V=.25, every output checked under original F32 budget. Both sides pass.
space.interpretation: Actual gallocr backing capacity is not total/instantaneous peak VRAM. Caller complete mask/Q/K/V/output counted separately; NativeWork hidden staging/pools, commands, driver allocations are not included. Address union demonstrates alias reuse, not peak simultaneously live score memory.

rejected_first_strategy.reason: Without the benefit guard, even same-F32 small-KV/wide-output domains allocated more for the concat frontier. These real negative points are retained, not reclassified as wins.
rejected_first_strategy.alignment_failure: Initial unaligned mask block caused native src1 descriptor-origin assertion; failing log retained. Quantum selection fixes this, not a shader change.

performance: No submit/wait latency or engine tokens/s timing; the stricter F32 operand path and output joins may have performance costs. This batch establishes correctness/space only.
cleanup: Root owns exact rebuildable manifest cleanup via test.ps1; no SDK/cache/native libs listed for removal.
